import math
import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    mod = 998244353
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    v = [0] * 10
    index = 2
    for _ in range(k):
        x = int(data[index])
        index += 1
        v[x] = 1

    ans = [1]
    p = n // 2

    # Precompute the FFT roots
    max_len = 1
    while max_len < (len(ans) + len(v) - 1):
        max_len <<= 1

    # Initialize roots for FFT
    cs = [0.0] * (max_len + 1)
    sn = [0.0] * (max_len + 1)
    csi = [0.0] * (max_len + 1)
    sni = [0.0] * (max_len + 1)

    length = 1
    while length <= max_len:
        for i in range(length // 2, length):
            angle = 2 * math.pi * (i - length // 2) / length
            cs[i] = math.cos(angle)
            sn[i] = math.sin(angle)
            csi[i] = math.cos(-angle)
            sni[i] = math.sin(-angle)
        length <<= 1

    def multiply_mod(a, b, mod):
        need = len(a) + len(b) - 1
        n = 1
        while n < need:
            n <<= 1

        aReal = [0.0] * n
        aImaginary = [0.0] * n
        for i in range(len(a)):
            x = a[i] % mod
            aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
            aImaginary[i] = x >> 15

        bReal = [0.0] * n
        bImaginary = [0.0] * n
        for i in range(len(b)):
            x = b[i] % mod
            bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
            bImaginary[i] = x >> 15

        fft(aReal, aImaginary, False)
        fft(bReal, bImaginary, False)

        faReal = [0.0] * n
        faImaginary = [0.0] * n
        fbReal = [0.0] * n
        fbImaginary = [0.0] * n

        for i in range(n):
            j = (n - i) & (n - 1)

            a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2
            a1i = (aImaginary[i] - aImaginary[j]) / 2
            a2r = (aImaginary[i] + aImaginary[j]) / 2
            a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2

            b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2
            b1i = (bImaginary[i] - bImaginary[j]) / 2
            b2r = (bImaginary[i] + bImaginary[j]) / 2
            b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2

            faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
            faImaginary[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i

            fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
            fbImaginary[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r

        fft(faReal, faImaginary, True)
        fft(fbReal, fbImaginary, True)

        res = [0] * need
        for i in range(need):
            aa = int(round(faReal[i]))
            bb = int(round(fbReal[i]))
            cc = int(round(faImaginary[i]))
            val = (aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod
            res[i] = val
        return res

    def fft(a, b, inverse):
        n = len(a)
        j = 0
        for i in range(1, n):
            bit = n >> 1
            while j & bit:
                j ^= bit
                bit >>= 1
            j |= bit
            if i < j:
                a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
                b[i], b[j] = b[j], b[i]
        length = 2
        while length <= n:
            half = length >> 1
            wlen = length
            for i in range(0, n, length):
                for j in range(half):
                    wA = csi[half + j] if inverse else cs[half + j]
                    wB = sni[half + j] if inverse else sn[half + j]
                    uA = a[i + j]
                    uB = b[i + j]
                    vA = a[i + j + half] * wA - b[i + j + half] * wB
                    vB = a[i + j + half] * wB + b[i + j + half] * wA
                    a[i + j] = uA + vA
                    b[i + j] = uB + vB
                    a[i + j + half] = uA - vA
                    b[i + j + half] = uB - vB
            length <<= 1
        if inverse:
            for i in range(n):
                a[i] /= n
                b[i] /= n

    while p > 0:

            ans = multiply_mod(ans, v, mod)
        p //= 2
        v = multiply_mod(v, v, mod)

    res = 0

    print(res)
